issues.explanation: Chapter 85 says Huang Quan was cut off on the north bank and had to surrender to Wei, but Chapter 84 omitted that Liu Bei appointed him to command the north-bank forces. His location and reason for surrender therefore arrive without setup.
issues.suggested_fix: In Chapter 84, add that Liu Bei appointed Huang Quan to command the north-bank troops and guard against Wei; or briefly restate this circumstance at the start of Chapter 85.
